diff --git a/tests/mutex-suspension.scm b/tests/mutex-suspension.scm
index e13b706e..74f6ef0f 100644
--- a/tests/mutex-suspension.scm
+++ b/tests/mutex-suspension.scm
@@ -11,10 +11,22 @@
 
 (define (slow-lock mutex timeout owner)
   (##declare (not interrupts-enabled))
-  (##check-heap-limit)
-  (##primitive-lock! mutex 1 9)
-  (if owner (##primitive-lock! owner 1 9))
-  (##mutex-lock-out-of-line! mutex timeout owner))
+  ;; Only the SMP implementation has this three-argument private protocol.
+  ;; The single-context build checks the same decisions through its public
+  ;; interface; it does not qualify the SMP slow-path ownership change.
+  (if (##c-code "
+#ifdef ___SINGLE_THREADED_VMS
+___RESULT = ___TRU;
+#else
+___RESULT = ___FAL;
+#endif
+")
+      (mutex-lock! mutex timeout owner)
+      (begin
+        (##check-heap-limit)
+        (##primitive-lock! mutex 1 9)
+        (if owner (##primitive-lock! owner 1 9))
+        (##mutex-lock-out-of-line! mutex timeout owner))))
 
 (define (await-mutex thread mutex)
   (let loop ()
diff --git a/tests/rc-root-origin.scm b/tests/rc-root-origin.scm
index 1e31ab9a..d4571d66 100644
--- a/tests/rc-root-origin.scm
+++ b/tests/rc-root-origin.scm
@@ -127,9 +127,12 @@ c-end
 
 (define (on-owner owner thunk)
   (let ((thread (make-thread thunk)))
-    (##thread-pin! thread (##processor owner))
+    (if (> (##current-vm-processor-count) 1)
+        (##thread-pin! thread (##processor owner)))
     (thread-start! thread) (thread-join! thread)))
-(##thread-pin! (current-thread) (##processor 0))
+;; A single execution context has no affinity choice or SMP pin primitive.
+(if (> (##current-vm-processor-count) 1)
+    (##thread-pin! (current-thread) (##processor 0)))
 (thread-yield!)
 (define rc-initial-members (##current-vm-processor-count))
 (for-each
diff --git a/tests/root-task.scm b/tests/root-task.scm
index b35a2df9..82128460 100644
--- a/tests/root-task.scm
+++ b/tests/root-task.scm
@@ -1405,7 +1405,8 @@ c-end
                         (error "bank moving root lost" owner)))
                   (write (list 'BANK-ROOT-MOVING-PASS 'owner owner)) (newline))
                 bank-clear)))))
-       (##thread-pin! thread (##processor owner))
+       (if (> (##current-vm-processor-count) 1)
+           (##thread-pin! thread (##processor owner)))
        (thread-start! thread) (thread-join! thread)))
    (if (> (##current-vm-processor-count) 1) '(0 1) '(0))))
